entries.name: Giantland — High score
entries.summary: Set a new high score in Giantland.
entries.reward: All 23 high-score records: Classic Tone and Classically Trained.
entries.instructions: Use left/right to avoid the giant. Ride the spoon onto the table; use Action on the curtain cord, then pepper. Time Action jumps between candle holders and the window. Finish the attempt (or exhaust lives in endless games) so the score registers. There is no preset score target; check for the Mickey completion stamp.
entries.minimumScoreRule: Any registered result; no fixed target. Golf uses a lower-is-better result.

entries.name: Ansem — Data battle
entries.instructions: Block the opening laser orbs, then use Thunder and Airstep to punish. When the tracking shadow expands, dodge its claws and then the closing crests; the following pause is a safe opening. For the charged third dash, use Risk Dodge after the guard break. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Xemnas — Data battle
entries.instructions: Block red lasers and dodge blue ones. His thorns cannot be guarded. During the dark arena sequence, guard his teleporting physical combos, but roll away from the X-shaped slash; attack after that slash finishes. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Xigbar — Data battle
entries.instructions: During the ring-shaped arena, move around the central gap; Airstep cannot cross it. Time blocks to each volley rather than firing blindly. After the fourth portal shot, Airstep in for an opening. His slow walking taunt is a trap. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Luxord — Data battle
entries.instructions: Win the time-gauge games. Strike red O cards once, then roll away to avoid hitting X cards. Rotate the camera to identify O cards that do not turn with it. In the final card walls, use the dispel prompt on Luxord images rather than broad swings. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Larxene — Data battle
entries.instructions: Guard the knife combo and use Risk Dodge after its guard-breaking finish. When she chains lightning pillars, avoid the sequence and Airstep in as the last pillar ends. Equip thunder resistance and preserve room to dodge her clones. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Marluxia — Data battle
entries.instructions: Use Counter Impact for its quick wide reprisal. Guard the first four close-range slashes and dodge the pink fifth. A Fire spell removes his armor after the tornado sequence, giving a strong punish opportunity. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Saïx — Data battle
entries.instructions: Equip Stun Protection. Guard the second swing of his opening feint combo, then Risk Dodge and counter. His thrown spinning claymore cannot be blocked; dodge it and Airstep in while he is empty-handed. Yellow and blue Berserk have different patterns. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Terra-Xehanort — Data battle
entries.instructions: Wait for him to re-summon the Keyblade after the Dark Figure’s combo, then punish. During the dark-pool attack, dodge the rotating rays and ground fissures; they cannot be blocked. Time the final dodge to the Figure’s ground slam. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Dark Riku — Data battle
entries.instructions: His barrier punishes reckless strikes. Guard normal swings, dodge red shock slashes and red slam waves, and attack the openings after combo finishers or during vulnerable air sequences. Keep clear of lingering mines. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Vanitas — Data battle
entries.instructions: Equip Freeze Protection. Guard the three downward warps, then Risk Dodge the final guard break and counter. Dodge toward his approaching red Shadow Dive circle. Preserve MP for Aero-based openings instead of spending it without a plan. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Young Xehanort — Data battle
entries.instructions: Equip Freeze Protection. Guard his delayed whip sequences and Risk Dodge guard-breaking finishes. The whip attack marked by a large clock is unblockable: dodge it, then wait for his follow-up teleport before attacking. Avoid striking his healing clock guard. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Xion — Data battle
entries.prerequisites: Clear Re Mind. Defeat the initial eleven data opponents.
entries.instructions: Blue light beams can be guarded but cause HP Break if they hit; gold beams require dodging. Panacea, Elixir or a formchange clears HP Break when codes allow them. After her armored ultimate sequence ends, punish her return to the arena center. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Master Xehanort — Data battle
entries.prerequisites: Clear Re Mind. Defeat the initial eleven data opponents.
entries.instructions: Watch for status-inflicting weapon transformations. Dodge tracking sky beams just before they fire. His spinning bombs may be blocked initially but still explode, so evade afterward. Keep defensive responses distinct from the base-game final boss. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.name: Yozora
entries.summary: Win the Secret Episode encounter; the loss ending is not a victory.
entries.prerequisites: Win all thirteen Limitcut data battles.
entries.instructions: Guard red attacks and dodge blue ones. Dodge the Keyblade-steal orb, then guard the follow-up slashes. Escape a forming drone pyramid before blocking his next strike. After the sixth aerial laser set, Airstep into his brief fall for an opening. He can steal and use a carried Kupo Coin. PRO codes can disable the suggested magic, items, forms or abilities; consult the code records and adjust the loadout.

entries.instructions: Embark at Corona, turn back toward the world and inspect the rock spires on the right. Enter photo mode and adjust distance/angle until the constellation is outlined as a valid target, then take the photo. Claim its Gummi Mission reward.

entries.name: Schwarzgeist
entries.summary: Enter the Misty Stream encounter with ship Speed at least 200.
entries.instructions: Reach 200 Speed; the Endymion constellation blueprint qualifies. A custom Highwind Peak can use Rocket/Booster blocks, Comet/Meteor cannons, Cannon Upgrade and Repair Kit; check its current cost/AP limits. Roll through laser-grid gaps and missiles; Golden Highwind is the victory reward, so it is available for later replays. A-rank replay option, after an initial Schwarzgeist victory: equip the rewarded Golden Highwind, Golden Falcon and Golden Invincible Teeny ships, and Repair Kit. Community players report success by destroying the missile pods, then repeatedly destroying regenerating shields while avoiding the main body; finish once the score reaches 1,000,000. Keep moving/rolling through attacks and heal with Repair Kit. This is a reported replay strategy, not a claim of an optimal or universally guaranteed loadout. Golden Highwind requires the prior clear, so use the starter guidance for the first victory.

entries.name: EZ — Deadly Blow
entries.summary: You can defeat enemies in one hit. However, certain enemies and bosses are immune to this effect.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code. Bosses with cutscenes dividing "phases" of the battle, such as the Catastrochorus in San Fransokyo , the Demon Tide , Saïx or any of Master Xehanort 's fights except the Data Replica, will merely be reduced to 1 HP before moving on to the next phase. Enemies and bosses with armor gauges that replace their HP gauges will have their armor gauge depleted by Deadly Blow without affecting their HP.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — Auto-block
entries.summary: Enemy attacks are automatically blocked. Auto-block does not activate when you are attacking, or when you are using forms with no blocking.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code. Sora will perform a block with no input when Auto-block is activated. However, he will not perform an auto-block during attack animations, even if a block can be activated via player input at that time.Unable to activate Critical Counter .
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — HP Regen
entries.summary: Your whole team's HP automatically regenerates.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code. If the PRO code "HP Slip" is activated, HP will not regenerate during battle, even when HP reaches dangerous levels,at which point HP is no longer being reduced by "HP Slip".
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — MP Regen
entries.summary: Your whole team's MP automatically regenerates. However, MP Regen does not activate while recharging MP.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code. If the PRO code "MP Slip" is activated, MP will not regenerate during battle.

entries.name: EZ — Focus Regen

entries.name: EZ — Form Charge
entries.summary: Your Formchange Gauge gradually increases over time.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code. The Situation Command meter will increase at a fixed rate, on top of contributions from the player's battle performance. For Sora and Aqua, a Formchange command will always be generated (if available); Double Duel and Dark Firaga will always be generated for Riku during the Demon Tower boss fight alongside Mickey and during later boss fights, respectively; Dual Shot and Seven Wishes will always be generated for Roxas and Kairi, respectively. Has no effect during an active Link Summon.

entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — AP Free
entries.summary: The AP cost of all abilities is reduced to 0. When toggling this code from ON to OFF, your whole team will have their set abilities removed.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — Survival
entries.summary: Strength and magic stats are tripled for both allies and enemies.
entries.instructions: Category: Battle Code.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — Cooking Master
entries.summary: You will always earn an Excellent rating when cooking with Little Chef .
entries.instructions: Category: Support Code.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — Shop Discount
entries.summary: All shop items are half price.
entries.instructions: Category: Support Code.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: EZ — Gummi Ship Meister
entries.summary: In Gummi Editor, your gummi ship level is set to 99, and your inventory of all gummi items will be set to maximum. Your previous inventory cannot be restored.
entries.instructions: Category: Support Code. This is the only EZ Code that cannot be disabled once activated.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — Default Status
entries.summary: Your whole team's stats are returned to their initial default status, regardless of level.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★★★. Only applies to stats directly gained from Level Ups. Stats from equipment, cuisine, and direct sources like the Strength Boost item are unaffected. The party's AP is unaffected. Riku , Aqua , Roxas , and Kairi have fixed stats when playable and are not affected.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — Zero Defense
entries.summary: Your whole team's defense is set to 0. However, Defense boosts from equipment are still applied.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★★.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — HP Slip
entries.summary: During battle, your whole team's HP automatically decreases over time until it reaches dangerous levels.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★. A given party member's HP will cease decreasing once it is considered "critical". If Sora's max HP is reduced to 1 by the HP Break status effect, HP Slip will not finish him off.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — MP Slip
entries.summary: During battle, your whole team's MP automatically decreases over time, and MP recharge time is doubled.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★★. If Sora's MP is reduced to 1, MP Slip will not trigger an MP recharge.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Shotlocks
entries.instructions: Category: ★★. Airstepping is still available.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Cure
entries.summary: Your whole team cannot use Cure magic.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★★★. This also includes Baymax's Care Spray ability.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Battle Items
entries.summary: During battle, your whole team cannot use items.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Links
entries.instructions: Category: ★★.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Formchanges/Grand Magic
entries.summary: You cannot use formchanges or grand magic.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★★. This also includes Kairi 's Seven Wishes finisher. Master Xehanort 's Ascension attack will still force Sora into Rage Form .
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Attractions
entries.summary: Attraction commands do not appear outside of certain special battles.
entries.instructions: Category: ★. The horde battle at the Keyblade Graveyard will still allow use of Mountain Coaster.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Team Attacks
entries.summary: Team commands do not appear outside of certain special battles.
entries.instructions: Category: ★. The Laugh Gauge battles in Monstropolis still allow use of Scream Strike , and the fight against Dark Baymax exclusively uses Baymax 's Interceptor Wing and is not disabled.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — No Kupo Coins
entries.summary: Kupo coins in your possession have no effect.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★. Yozora 's Energy Break attack is still capable of stealing a Kupo Coin and he is still capable of using it, if Sora possesses one.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: PRO — Ability Limit
entries.summary: A maximum limit of 30 is placed on abilities you can install on Sora.
entries.instructions: Category: ★★★★. If Sora has more than 30 abilities installed, activating this PRO Code deactivates all of them.
entries.prerequisites: Easy Adventure selects EZ; Challenging Adventure selects PRO; defeating Yozora unlocks both menus on this save.

entries.name: Re Mind save continuation
entries.summary: Start Re Mind from a cleared base save; retain a separate source save and separate Scala save.
entries.instructions: A DLC save can resume base content using the alternate Load prompt (Square on PS, X on Xbox). Return using the DLC continuation prompt after saving base progress into that same DLC file. A separate old base save is not a live link to an existing DLC continuation.
entries.uncertainty: Console prompts are documented. Steam keyboard/controller glyphs and exact overwrite/replay edge cases have not been independently evidenced.

entries.name: New Game Plus carryover
entries.summary: Carry acquired Keyblades and selfie poses into a new game; imported Keyblades start at level 0.
entries.instructions: Proof items also carry over. Ordinary synthesis gives Ultima at level 10; only an imported level-0 Ultima needs its forge ladder. Keep the descendant save separate from its source.

entries.instructions: Every result consumes ingredients. Good makes the normal dish; Excellent makes +. Chef Extraordinaire widens the success window and stacks. Cooking autosaves; a manual save is distinct from Continue.

entries.name: Crack the Egg
entries.summary: Separate the sticks slowly. Stop when red sparks appear, then press both shoulder buttons together; further stick movement can break the yolk.
entries.instructions: Every result consumes ingredients. Good makes the normal dish; Excellent makes +. Chef Extraordinaire widens the success window and stacks. Cooking autosaves; a manual save is distinct from Continue.

entries.name: Flambé the Food
entries.summary: Rotate the left stick at a steady pace to pour. Wait for the red sparks, then lower the right stick to ignite.
entries.instructions: Every result consumes ingredients. Good makes the normal dish; Excellent makes +. Chef Extraordinaire widens the success window and stacks. Cooking autosaves; a manual save is distinct from Continue.

entries.name: Grind the Pepper
entries.summary: Alternate left/right stick flicks as the moving ring meets the appropriate hand’s icon.
entries.instructions: Every result consumes ingredients. Good makes the normal dish; Excellent makes +. Chef Extraordinaire widens the success window and stacks. Cooking autosaves; a manual save is distinct from Continue.

entries.name: Pooh’s Hunny Harvest
entries.summary: Play the flower-harvest game at Rabbit’s House.
entries.instructions: At Rabbit’s House, inspect the flower-garden sign near Gopher. Drop honey pots to raise Pooh’s level and extend the timer. Rewards are repeatable; Honey is not shop stock.
entries.uncertainty: Honey quantities are sourced; the complete named rank table and randomized medal-ability variants in other minigames remain unverified.

entries.name: Lucky Strike stacking
entries.summary: Enemy drop multiplier: 1 + 0.3 × equipped Lucky Strike copies in the active party.
entries.instructions: For example, three copies multiply a listed base rate by 1.9. This describes enemy prize-box drops, not a guaranteed postcard or Orichalcum+ reward. Do not rank farms by drop rate alone.

entries.name: Prize Postcard lottery
entries.summary: Purchasing during a Moogle Shop visit can award a postcard; spending more does not improve the chance.
entries.instructions: Mail it at the box beside Twilight Town’s Moogle shop. Rewards are random. The Orichalcum+ is one of seven unique acquisition events, not a repeatable ore farm.

entries.name: Treasure Sphere α
entries.summary: Shoot the circuit gears into alignment to open the sphere.
entries.reward: Fira/G x4, Blizzara/G x4, Water/G x4, Booster/G x2, Propeller/G x1, Roman One/S , EXP prize (big x50)
entries.instructions: On the Starlight Way embarkation map, select Treasure Sphere α and use the displayed marker action. Target sequence: T-shape (6 seconds) -> X-shape (3 seconds) -> N-shape (6 seconds) Sphere treasure rewards are collected once; they are not an ordinary-asteroid refill farm.

entries.name: Gummi build budgeting
entries.summary: Custom ships must fit their current block-cost and ability-point limits.
entries.instructions: Part cost, power, speed and ability AP are separate. Level-gated abilities are listed separately; Cost Converter exchanges teeny-ship capacity for main-ship budget. Special blueprints can be flown without treating their cost as a custom-build allowance. At Gummi level 99, the base custom-ship cost limit is 1,000. This endpoint does not establish the cost or AP limit at every intervening level. The Xbox walkthrough publishes a combined Main + Teeny budget table from 500 at level 1 to 1,600 at level 99. That aggregate is not the base main-ship allowance of 1,000. The per-ship split and AP-cap curve are not supplied by that table.
entries.uncertainty: A complete published 99-level combined-budget table is retained as source evidence; it is not a certified Steam per-ship build calculator. Main/Teeny split at each level and AP-cap progression remain unverified.

publishedCombinedCost.unit: Main Ship plus Teeny Ships total; not main ship alone
publishedCombinedCost.retrieval: Complete indexed table; direct page returned HTTP 402
